hookText: Clover-35B-A3B: DiffuSpace publishes the tech report and SFT code

beats.say: DiffuSpace released the technical report and supervised fine-tuning code for Clover-35B-A3B-Preview, a mixture-of-experts diffusion language model built on Qwen3.6-35B-A3B and aimed at agentic tasks.
Clover leads the seven evaluated agent metrics, including 73.6 on SWE-bench Verified and 51.7 on Terminal-Bench 2.1.
On an internal set of 500 groups, joint prediction raises question accuracy from 90.37% to 93.88% and all-correct group accuracy from 65.4% to 77.0%.
